hypotheses.claim: The W-adjacent horizontal, diagonal and neighboring line centers are within a sub-point junction neighborhood at the grid's left border.
The W-adjacent horizontal line is not suppressed by an SVG clipPath ancestor and raster samples support actual ink along the predicted centerline.
Some of the eleven clip contexts affect elements beyond the Figure1 connector foreground; one-to-one source-figure mapping cannot be assumed.
A proximity cluster identifies the author's intended W field action on specific fermion entries.

falsifiers: Frozen PDF / exact SVG / earlier 96dpi raster hash mismatch aborts before source conclusions.

A supposedly valid clip reference lacks a `<clipPath>` definition, or clipping logic could not resolve source visibility.
Raster displaced controls show comparable darkness or source scale/resolution mismatch: no verified raster-to-vector support.
Source topology does not imply physical W/g action even if ink lines meet; source text action claims remain a separate ledger.

No L current gate / SSC promotion, source-inverse rewrite, W semantics import, synthesis, outreach, or PR merge without independent G0 qualification.
